title: Tweaked & Animated
description: A minecraft texture that animates various items and blocks.
body:
Tweaked & Animated is a minecraft texture that animates items and blocks (not including the netherite armor which is not animated)..
This texture aims to change and animate minecraft items which changes and makes the game more alive.
This texture not only adds animations to items and blocks, but even tweaks that makes the game more enjoyable

To report bugs or suggest items to animate, feel free to contanct patys7618 or mogino0401 on discord.

My patreon: patreon.com/ImPatysoo

Images are outdated.
